key_highlights: Miners and tech stocks lead the ASX to a third consecutive week of gains despite broader macroeconomic headwinds.
Australian unemployment surges to a five-year high, precipitating an AUD/USD selloff while easing RBA cash rate hike pressures.
Sydney property auction clearance rates deteriorate sharply, heightening macro credit risks for major banking institutions.
Junior resource players fast-track gold and critical mineral production to capitalise on elevated global commodity pricing.

sectors.trend: Strong momentum in gold, rare earths, and base metals driving broad resources outperformance.
sectors.implications: Exploration upside and accelerated production timelines support cash flows, offsetting fears of 'China Shock 2.0' on bulk commodities.

sectors.trend: Margin pressure compounding as rising unemployment and auction weakness heighten loan-loss provisions.
sectors.implications: Major banks face asset quality scrutiny and moderated credit growth, mitigated only by expectations of an RBA rate plateau.

sectors.trend: Sustained rally tracking global risk appetite and domestic institutional inflows.
sectors.implications: Multiple expansion remains intact as softening bond yields provide valuation relief for growth tech assets.

sectors.trend: Structural domestic gas supply deficits colliding with regulatory and decarbonisation compliance mandates.
sectors.implications: East Coast gas constraints threaten industrial margins while offering upside realisations for uncontracted domestic producers.

sectors.trend: Severe divergence between residential auction distress and selective commercial/industrial resilience.
sectors.implications: Residential developers face margin compression, while diversified REITs benefit from long-term capital preservation.

key_themes: RBA Policy Pivot: Rising unemployment removes near-term rate hike risks, resetting interest rate expectations.
Macroeconomic Deterioration: Weakening consumer fundamentals and auction slowdowns heighten domestic cyclical risks.
Resource Sector Resilience: Upstream precious metals and critical minerals decouple from domestic macro weakness.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight consumer discretionary and domestic cyclicals; overweight defensive healthcare and sovereign bond proxies.
Reduce direct exposure to high-leverage retail banks and residential builders; monitor bad debt provisioning.
Diversify commodity exposure into gold and critical minerals; hedge bulk iron ore downside via options.
Maintain exposure to domestic upstream energy producers with unhedged East Coast volume exposure.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Producers
opportunities.rationale: Strong commodity price backdrop and accelerated production schedules insulate miners from domestic economic softening.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to ASX Quality Technology
opportunities.rationale: Sector outperformance supported by moderating sovereign yields following weak employment print.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Escalating mortgage stress and rising five-year high unemployment increase credit impairment risks for mortgage-heavy lenders.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Index Downside via Benchmark Put Protection
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing and labour market cracks threaten domestic earnings breadth despite resource momentum.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as resources and tech strength battle headwinds from banking and consumer weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive medium-term recovery contingent on RBA easing cycles and resilient commodity export earnings.

Quarterly CPI inflation print confirming disinflationary momentum
Sydney and Melbourne auction clearance rates and house price indices
Chinese industrial production data and stimulus implementation
